first_observations.v1_harness_stop: The P-owned runner incorrectly required a successful atomic named-output replacement to preserve the destination inode; no lineage challenge was reached.
first_observations.v2_actual_baseline: A coherent substitution of a second live CHECK-issued Unknown u8 call result and its corresponding callee root was accepted by the private predicate consumer, direct call validator, and outer validator: 1/1/1.

repair.contract: CHECK privately seals the issued call view and complete canonical callee subtree before publication. The bounded predicate consumer validates those immutable bytes before reading the live call/body graph.
repair.repaired_tuple: coherent substitution 0/0/0; genuine and restored 1/1/1; partial substitutions 0/0/0

oom.new_points_explanation: Three actual calls each seal one body and two canonical IF-arm node arrays.
oom.all_reached_points: OUT_OF_MEMORY with no publication; named bytes/inode/mtime/temp no-clobber; fault-off retry exact

local_targeted_validation.gcc13_and_clang23_strict_c17_native: all four sources, raw and passive, O0/O2 PASS with exact values

limits: The repair authenticates only the existing finite pure one-usize-formal/u8-result predicate profile.
It does not establish general compiler soundness or a cyclic LOOP/CONTINUE invariant.
Full local regression and hosted CI results are reported separately because they occur after this evidence artifact is sealed.
value_alignment_risk: The extra private node snapshots increase trusted-code surface, retained memory, OOM sites, and future re-audit cost. The requested UB-prevention audit-locality comparison remains UNMEASURED; Product GO remains outside this result.
